initialDefinition.workflowName: Search and Pagination For Notes API

steps.prompt:
Skim the existing Notes API before any design work starts: @src/store/notesStore.ts,
@src/routes/notes.ts, @tests/notes.test.ts.

Summarize in 6-10 short bullet points: how the in-memory store is shaped, how routes
validate input and report errors (status codes, error body shape), and how the existing
tests are organized. This is a quick scan to ground the plan that follows — not a full
audit, and don't propose any changes yet.
steps.name: research

steps.prompt:
$previous

Using that scan of the existing code, design tagging, search, and pagination for this Notes
API (Express, TypeScript):
- Add a `tags: string[]` field to notes, settable on create and update.
- `GET /notes` should accept `tag` (exact match), `q` (case-insensitive substring search over
  title + body), `page`, and `pageSize` query params — all optional and combinable.
- Decide the pagination defaults and bounds (page size cap, 1-indexed vs 0-indexed, what an
  out-of-range page returns) and the response shape (array only, or array plus page/total
  metadata?).
- Decide tag validation rules (empty strings, duplicates, casing).

Write the plan to `.ctrlyoke/plans/notes-tagging-search.md`: the endpoint contract, the store
changes, and the specific decisions above. Don't write any implementation code yet.
steps.name: plan

endCondition.retryPrompt: .ctrlyoke/plans/notes-tagging-search.md was not created. Write the plan to it.

steps.prompt:
Review the plan in @.ctrlyoke/plans/notes-tagging-search.md as a second opinion — you did not
write it. Check it against the real code (@src/store/notesStore.ts, @src/routes/notes.ts):
does the pagination behavior it chose actually make sense (bounds, defaults, out-of-range
handling), is the search case-insensitivity well-specified, are the tag validation rules
complete? Update the plan file directly with your corrections, and note anything you
deliberately left alone.
steps.name: plan-review

steps.prompt:
Implement the plan in @.ctrlyoke/plans/notes-tagging-search.md in full:
- Update `src/store/notesStore.ts` and `src/routes/notes.ts` (add a shared type in
  `src/types/` if the plan calls for one).
- Update `tests/notes.test.ts` to cover tagging, search, and pagination, including the edge
  cases the plan calls out.
- Update `README.md`'s endpoint table and add a short section documenting the new query
  parameters.

Complete implementation only — no TODOs, stubs, or placeholders.
steps.name: implement

endCondition.retryPrompt:
npm test is still failing. Fix the remaining issues:

$endCondition:stdout

steps.prompt:
Review the finished tagging/search/pagination implementation against
@.ctrlyoke/plans/notes-tagging-search.md — again as a second opinion. Look for correctness
bugs, pagination off-by-one errors, case-sensitivity mistakes in search, unvalidated tag
input, and any drift from the plan. Fix what you find directly in the code, then summarize
what you changed and why in a short paragraph.
steps.name: review

steps.prompt:
Review the working tree changes (~diff) and commit them with a conventional commit message
(`feat(notes): description`). No attribution or generated-by trailers.
steps.name: commit
